text: With seeds 70-72, N=64, m2 in [0.1, 1] and 600 steps held fixed, does raw layer-4 accel_step R2 at e ceilings of 0.75 and 0.8 fall linearly from about 0.80 (e<=0.7) to about 0.56 (e<=0.85), or does most of the drop happen in one interval? Is the drop concentrated in pericentre snapshots (r/a < 0.3) that only appear above e=0.7?
